badge.text: Expense Intelligence Platform · For Finance Teams

headline: Control Every Business Expense Without the Spreadsheet Chaos.
description: The Expense Management Platform Built for Growing SMEs & Mid-Market Businesses. Track expenses, automate reimbursements, enforce policies, and gain real-time visibility into company spending—all from one powerful platform.
highlightText: Stop Losing Money to Manual Processes
subDescription: Expendesk helps finance, operations, and leadership teams eliminate expense chaos, reduce financial leakage, and make smarter spending decisions at scale.

featureCards.title: Leakage Detection
featureCards.description: Auto-flags duplicates, over-limit claims & policy violations before they hit payout.

featureCards.title: Multi-Level Approvals
featureCards.description: Structured workflows with partial approvals, delegation, and escalation paths.

featureCards.title: Full Audit Trail
featureCards.description: Every edit, approval, and payout logged with timestamps and actor identity.

featureCards.title: Faster Month-End
featureCards.description: Eliminate back-and-forth. Finance closes books in days, not weeks.
